Weekly In-Class Activities

ECN 4199 — Weekly In-Class Activities

This page contains the weekly in-class activities for:

ECN 4199 — Industrial Data Analytics

These activities form the continuous assessment component of the course and are designed to provide hands-on analytical experience throughout the semester.

Purpose of Weekly Activities

The weekly activities are designed to help students:

  • apply weekly concepts in real time
  • develop computational confidence
  • strengthen analytical reasoning
  • improve interpretation skills
  • engage actively during lectures
  • gain practical experience using Python and analytics tools

The purpose is NOT memorization.

The purpose is learning how to:

  • think computationally
  • solve analytical problems
  • interpret outputs critically
  • communicate evidence effectively

Assessment Structure

Item Details
Number of Activities 13
Marks per Activity 5 Marks
Total Marks 65 Marks
Duration Approximately 1 Hour per Activity
Completion Mode During Scheduled Lecture Session
Submission Method Through Relevant Weekly Submission Link

Important Instructions

Students must:

  1. Attend the scheduled lecture session.
  2. Open the relevant weekly activity page.
  3. Complete the activity within the allocated lecture period.
  4. Submit all required materials before the submission deadline.

Late submissions will normally not be accepted unless prior approval has been obtained from the lecturer.

How the Weekly Activities Work

Each activity may include a combination of:

  • conceptual questions
  • Python coding tasks
  • visualization exercises
  • interpretation questions
  • forecasting exercises
  • machine learning tasks
  • dashboard exercises
  • short reflection questions

Students are expected to demonstrate both:

  • technical execution
  • analytical interpretation

Correct code without interpretation is insufficient.

Similarly, interpretation without computational implementation is also insufficient.

Google Colab Submission Instructions

Most weekly activities will require students to work using:

Google Colab Notebooks

Students should follow the process below carefully.

Step 1 — Open the Notebook

Open the relevant notebook link provided within the weekly lecture materials.

Step 2 — Save a Personal Copy

Inside Google Colab:

File → Save a Copy in Drive

This creates your own editable version.

Students should NEVER directly edit shared lecture notebooks.

Step 3 — Complete the Activity

Students should:

  • write code
  • answer interpretation questions
  • generate outputs
  • save all completed work properly

Step 4 — Rename the Notebook Properly

Rename the notebook using the following structure:

WeekNumber_IndexNumber_Name.ipynb

Example:

Week05_2024BA12345_Perera.ipynb

Step 5 — Enable Sharing

Inside Google Colab:

Share → General Access → Anyone with the Link → Viewer

This step is extremely important.

If sharing access is not enabled properly, the notebook cannot be evaluated.

Step 6 — Submit the Notebook Link

Copy the notebook URL and submit it through the relevant weekly submission link.
